def.name: Mavericks
def.description: The high-octane index. Every month Mavericks buys the eight vaults with the best trailing 30-day return per unit of drawdown (Calmar ratio) — only vaults at least 60 days old, managing $100k or more, whose drawdown over those same 30 days stayed under 20%. It rides strong momentum while favoring vaults that earned it smoothly. Equal weighted; re-selected and rebalanced on the 1st of every month.
